decision: Nominate a narrower persistence comparison or report return/reversal/heterogeneous context; no expanded positive set or NAM/repair mechanism.
strongest_rival: Unknown control harvest duration, preparation sharing and batch plus compositional/length effects can explain cross-sectional RNA differences without maintenance or withdrawal effects.
discriminator: All six fixed targets in each of six exact libraries, all-gene source-total CPM and raw-CPM means/ranges; show each library without pairing or a population model.
exposure_record: Prior DY1 target outcomes and source article figures exposed. New file qualification scanned numeric structure and library totals; one non-target first row was displayed. No target CPM/condition outcome accessed before this freeze. Not an unexposed confirmatory test.

nesting_and_overlap: Six measured libraries from one study and three conditions; same suffix does not establish pairing. No six-independent-mice or cross-assay independence claim.
population_and_selection: GSE247943: WT-CTR_1/2, WT-IL4_24h_1/2 and WT-pIL4_1/2, exact GSM and source-row mapping; Stat6,Egr2,Pparg,Rxra,Irf4 with separate Arg1. No KO or secondary stimulus subset.
contrast: Library-level source control, initial24-hour IL4 and post-IL4 context shown side by side; raw-CPM condition means/ranges, no trajectory or causal effect.
endpoint: Deposited reported gene-count/estimate CPM, normalized by sum of all24411 source gene values per library; log2(CPM+1) library-point display. RNA is not regulator activity.
methods: Whitespace parser with exact52-column join,24411 unique symbols, source-total and six-target identity verification. Preserve finite nonnegative fractional/zero values. missingness_and_exclusions: Stop for source/hash/column/GSM/gene mapping failure, duplicate or missing target, nonfinite/negative value, nonpositive denominator or source-total discrepancy. Missing target is not zero. No denominator gene filtering.
multiplicity: No tests, intervals, fold-change estimates, ranking, composite score, inferred pairing, batch correction or extra targets.

stop_rule: Refuse existing outputs and stop for any frozen input, parser, mapping, denominator or dimension mismatch; preserve failure and request an explicit versioned correction.
